description: Agora BFF capability manifest v1.5 - dynamic Trading Room workspace proposal, widget revision proposal, and workspace version routes.

capabilities.name: agora.trading_room.workspace_proposal.v1
capabilities.description: Create, retrieve, and accept complete TradingRoomWorkspaceProposal previews before a trader enters an active workspace.

capabilities.name: agora.trading_room.workspace_editing.v1
capabilities.description: Persist controlled trader edits to views, widgets, and layout through schema-validated TradingRoomWidgetSpec payloads.

capabilities.name: agora.trading_room.widget_revision.v1
capabilities.description: Require servant-originated widget changes to pass through WidgetRevisionProposal before/after preview and trader acceptance.

capabilities.name: agora.trading_room.workspace_versions.v1
capabilities.description: Expose append-only TradingRoomDashboardVersion change log and rollback for per-trader, per-strategy-version workspaces.

note: The v1.5 surface is additive over v1.4 and mirrors the already landed Trading Room BFF dynamic workspace routes. It does not authorize direct trading actions or arbitrary frontend code generation.
